correctness.rationale: Two-draw enumeration gives (1+s₂)s₃−2s₂². Padding to four coordinates, Cauchy–Schwarz on the other three bounds each coordinate by the larger root a of 4x²−2x+1−3s₂=0. With b=(1−a)/3, summing (x−b)²(x−a)≤0 and matching the first two power sums shows s₃≤a³+3b³. The resulting covariance bound is 2(a−1)³(16a²−2a+1)/27, which is strict for all non-point-mass laws. The five-letter witness gives 1/1600. Uniform laws give the negative values; continuity first extends positivity to each larger effective support and then produces an interior zero on the line to the uniform law. Independent exact enumeration of the witness and a uniform law and symbolic replay of the factor are in python /workspace/review_evidence/reproduce_1234.py 3. This is fixed-law covariance at sample size two, not a risk or pointwise guarantee.
